scope: Read-only independent safety review of SQL partition orchestration, merge validation, target isolation, interruption and cleanup. No tests or edits by reviewer.
observations: Each partition runs against an independently guarded target.
A failed child cannot produce a merged PASS.
Merge requires exact disjoint case coverage, current source hash and preservation of both copies.
Parent reconstruction validates actual child reports and full reviewed fault pairs and outcomes.
Stage interruption reaches coordinator and both children; owned-copy cleanup follows joined execution.
Four-copy cleanup includes the second SQL copy.
limitation: A failed partition waits for its sibling before the coordinator reports failure; this delays reporting but cannot produce PASS.
